guard: a detached spawn the manager refuses before its first effect is reported as a refusal (exit 2) carrying the manager's own reason, and nothing launches
why: A missing persona is refused before the manager reserves a name or writes a file, so SPEC 13.3
lets it say `not-executed`. Two halves have to hold for the operator to see that: the manager
has to state the outcome on the spawn goal's accept refusal, and the CLI has to print the
manager's reason. Each half gets its own row because either one failing leaves the other green.
The suite imports the manager and the CLI from their dist, so every row builds first and
rebuilds the mutated package after restore.

mutations.name: the spawn goal's accept refusal drops its outcome, so a missing persona reads as an unknown launch
mutations.find: rejectAccept(new EpEnvelopeError("failed-precondition", reply.error ?? "spawn refused at accept", details, effectStarted ? undefined : "not-executed"));
mutations.replace: rejectAccept(new EpEnvelopeError("failed-precondition", reply.error ?? "spawn refused at accept", details));
mutations.expectRed: a missing persona is a refusal the manager stated before execution, exit 2
mutations.cell: a missing persona is a refusal the manager stated before execution, exit 2
mutations.note: The shipped behavior before this change: the CLI printed an unconfirmed outcome and exit 3 for a launch that never started.

mutations.name: the CLI replaces the manager's refusal reason with a generic line
mutations.find: reply.error ? oneLine(reply.error) : "the manager refused the launch before execution", { target, native, remedy: "nothing was launched; fix what the manager reported, then run the spawn again" }
mutations.replace: "the manager refused the launch before execution", { target, native, remedy: "nothing was launched; fix what the manager reported, then run the spawn again" }
mutations.expectRed: ...it shows the manager's reason, naming the persona file it looked for
mutations.cell: ...it shows the manager's reason, naming the persona file it looked for
mutations.note: The outcome and exit code stay right, so the first cell stays green; only the reason, the path the manager looked for, disappears.
